chunks: I call to witness the star when it dips.

key_terms.النَّجْمِ: The star (genitive case due to oath)

ai.seo_question: What does the oath of the star in Surah An-Najm signify?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the certainty of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) vision and the authenticity of the divine revelation received during the Mi'raj. The term 'hawā' is interpreted by scholars like Allama Tabatabai as referring to the setting of the Pleiades, symbolizing the precise timing and reliability of the message delivered to the ummah.
